thread:
alex: Heads up — pushed package export map changes in @redwood/sdk@0.8.0 and it looks like we removed the legacy CJS fallback. Onboarding sample (./examples/onboarding) fails on Cloudflare Workers and Node 14 environments. Repro: `require('@redwood/sdk')` throws.

maria: Oof, can you paste the error? Cloudflare often resolves exports weirdly. :facepalm:

alex: Error from the worker when importing the sample:```Error: The requested module '@redwood/sdk' does not provide an export named 'default' at file:///workspace/examples/onboarding/worker.mjs:3:1```

sam: Also seeing TS compile failures in the sample app when using `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` — types expect a default export but the new ESM-only entry uses named exports. Lots of teams will hit this during onboarding.

jordan: Two problems here: (1) runtime resolution in edge runtimes that prefer the `exports` map conditional to `worker`/`browser` and (2) typings that still advertise a default. We probably introduced the breaking change when we cleaned up `main`/`module` fields.

lia: I'm going to open a compatibility PR that adds a CJS fallback entry and re-introduces a default export wrapper for TS consumers. Will target a patch (0.8.1). I think we can also add a note in onboarding README about import styles. cc @maria @sam

alex: Thanks — can we also hotfix the onboarding deploy? CI sample apps are failing `yarn test` because jest/ts-jest loads via CJS. Current temporary workaround for users is:```// use named imports
import * as Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
// or
const Redwood = require('@redwood/sdk').default || require('@redwood/sdk')```

maria: For Cloudflare Workers, folks will prefer `import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk'` so adding named exports back is good. But we should be explicit in changelog about ESM/CJS semantics.

sam: Quick note: auth/retry infra also relies on a small shim that expects `Redwood.default` shape. If we change exports, make sure the retry middleware import path in `packages/auth` is compatible. I can run tests across dedupe matrix.

lia: Created PR #4021 — adds `exports."."` CJS fallback and a `cjs/index.js` that re-exports the ESM bundle with `module.exports = require('../dist/esm').default || require('../dist/esm')`. Marked as patch.

jordan: Can we also add a CI job that runs the onboarding samples in Cloudflare Worker emulation? This would have caught it. Filed ISSUE-1284.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: Canary release `@redwood/sdk@0.8.1-canary.0` published for verification.

alex: Testing canary now against onboarding sample — initial smoke looks good, worker no longer crashes on import. :relieved:

maria: After we merge, we should update the SDK README import examples to show both `import * as` and `import { }` patterns and call out Node <12 CJS quirks.

sam: I'll run full auth/retry test matrix and report back. If green, we cut patch and backport to Dedicated docs.

lia: PR #4021 -> #4022 (patch after tests). Will include a short migration note and add an automated sample test to CI.

alex: Awesome — keep me posted. Thanks for the quick turnaround team. :shipit:
